items.text: Karch Klos joins the Zhou Lab as a Master's student! He will work on AI and supply chains. Welcome, Karch!
Dr. Zhou is appointed Assistant Editor of Food Research International.
Dr. Zhou is appointed Co-Chair of the Technical Program Committee for the IMPI Symposium 2027 in Seattle (June 22–24, 2027).
Dr. Zhou gives an invited talk on AI and microwave heating at the IMPI Symposium.
Dr. Zhou joins the Department of Food Science at Penn State.
